notes: Sections follow the chapter's own slide sequence; page 768-770 summary slides are merged with the cost slides (771-774) because they are pure recap. The exam guide emphasizes Task 1.2 (NACLs, security groups, route tables, public/private segmentation) and Task 4.4 (NAT gateway cost comparisons, private-vs-public IP transfer costs, VPC endpoint vs NAT Gateway), so Section 3 and Section 8 carry the heaviest scenario weight. Frequent distractors: treating VPC peering as transitive, forgetting ephemeral port rules on NACLs, assuming NAT Gateway is cross-AZ resilient, and picking interface endpoints over gateway endpoints for S3 inside a region. Regional NAT Gateway (p723) is a newer feature — verify current docs before relying on memorized limits.
